steps.say: Mixed connective tissue disease is an overlap autoimmune disorder blending systemic lupus erythematosus, systemic sclerosis, and polymyositis. It is occurring with extremely high titers of antibodies against U1-small nuclear ribonucleoprotein. Overlap is defining it while U1-RNP is confirming it.
steps.tx: **Mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD, Sharp syndrome)** is an overlap autoimmune disorder blending **systemic lupus erythematosus**, **systemic sclerosis**, and **polymyositis**. It is occurring with extremely high titers of antibodies against **U1-small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U1-snRNP)**. Overlap is defining it while **U1-RNP** is confirming it.

vis.caption: MCTD: three diseases overlapping around anti-U1-RNP. Criteria details are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: High-titer anti-U1-RNP antibodies are recognizing the 68-kDa, A, and C proteins of the spliceosome. All validated criteria sets are requiring them, including Alarcon-Segovia, Kasukawa, and Sharp. Antibodies of other diseases are staying absent, including anti-dsDNA, anti-Sm, and anti-Scl-70. One antibody is entering while all others are staying out.

steps.say: Raynaud phenomenon is affecting more than 95 percent of MCTD patients. Diffuse puffy swelling of the hands is forming sausage fingers. Non-erosive inflammatory polyarthritis is joining esophageal hypomotility. Mild inflammatory myopathy with raised muscle enzymes is completing the picture. Puffy hands with white fingers are pointing upward.

steps.say: Pulmonary arterial hypertension is causing most disease-related deaths in MCTD. It is developing in 15 to 25 percent of patients with an insidious onset. Severe interstitial lung disease is often missing when pressures are rising. Annual echocardiographic screening is mandated for every patient. Echo yearly is catching silent pressures.

Severe **interstitial lung disease** is often missing when pressures are rising. **Annual echocardiographic screening** is mandated for every patient. Echo yearly is catching silent pressures.

steps.say: Severe progressive renal disease is staying uncommon in pure MCTD. Membranous nephropathy or mild mesangial disease is appearing when kidneys are involved. Diffuse proliferative lupus nephritis is remaining rare in this setting. Its arrival is signaling transition toward definitive systemic lupus erythematosus. Membranous is staying while proliferative is straying.

Diffuse **proliferative lupus nephritis** is remaining rare in this setting. Its arrival is signaling transition toward definitive **systemic lupus erythematosus**. Membranous is staying while proliferative is straying.

steps.say: Up to 30 to 50 percent of patients first labeled MCTD are evolving into another single disease over decades. Systemic sclerosis is receiving most of them, followed by systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjogren disease. Follow-up is reclassifying the overlap into one entity. Labels are drifting toward single diseases.
steps.tx: Up to **30 to 50 percent** of patients first classified as MCTD are evolving into another single, well-defined systemic autoimmune disease over decades. **Systemic sclerosis** is receiving most of them, followed by **systemic lupus erythematosus** and **Sjogren disease**. Longitudinal follow-up is reclassifying the overlap into one entity. Labels are drifting toward single diseases.

rows: Systemic sclerosis, lupus, or Sjogren disease
Reclassify the overlap when one disease declares itself

steps.say: Scleromyositis is fusing systemic sclerosis with inflammatory myositis in one patient. Anti-PM-Scl-75 and PM-Scl-100 or anti-Ku antibodies are flagging the overlap. Proximal muscle weakness is joining mechanic hands with sclerodactyly. Severe interstitial lung disease is threatening the course. Two diseases are sharing one patient.

steps.say: Treatment is following the dominant organ manifestation in MCTD. Mild arthritis with serositis and puffy hands is yielding to hydroxychloroquine with low-to-moderate glucocorticoids. Severe myositis with rapidly progressive lung or major organ disease is demanding mycophenolate mofetil or cyclophosphamide. Mild disease is getting gentle drugs while severe disease is getting strong ones.
